title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): New system flow fields (SystemCreatedByUserName, SystemCreatedByFullName, SystemModifiedByUserName, and SystemModifiedByFullName)
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29) introduces four new system FlowFields (SystemCreatedByUserName, SystemCreatedByFullName, SystemModifiedByUserName, SystemModifiedByFullName) that display the username and full name of users who created or modified records, complementing the existing GUID-based audit fields.
key_points: Four new system FlowFields added to normal and temporary tables for auditing purposes
Fields provide readable usernames and full names instead of just GUIDs from SystemCreatedBy/SystemModifiedBy
Eliminates need for custom processing or extensions to display user names in pages
Can be exposed on UI through Customize pages for profiles, Analysis Mode, or AL customization

quotes.text: If we simply add it to the page, this will only show the GUID (User Security Id).
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the problem the new FlowFields solve - the old system fields displayed only GUIDs without additional processing

quotes.text: But finally, in this major release (BC29), Microsoft added these new system FlowFields: SystemCreatedByUserName, SystemCreatedByFullName, SystemModifiedByUserName, and SystemModifiedByFullName!
quotes.why_it_matters: Marks the significant milestone of these fields finally being available as built-in FlowFields after being needed for years
